a.from: cells L1 quiz 1, live test part 8, #4
a.question_text: Which of the following best describes the main difference between a prokaryotic cell and a eukaryotic cell?
options: A) Prokaryotic cells have a cell membrane, while eukaryotic cells do not.
B) Eukaryotic cells perform photosynthesis, while prokaryotic cells do not.
C) Prokaryotic cells are always larger than eukaryotic cells.
D) Eukaryotic cells possess a membrane-bound nucleus, which prokaryotic cells lack.
